questions.subtopic: People by Behaviour: Self-Centered vs Boastful
questions.question: Which of the following words correctly describes a person who excessively talks about himself and his own importance?
questions.explanation: Rule RC-01 ke anusaar, jo vyakti hamesha apni hi baatein aur apni hi tareef karta rehta hai use 'Egotist' kehte hain (T stands for Talk). 'Egoist' apne faayde aur swarth ke liye act karta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question: What is the term for a person who asserts that nothing is known or knowable about whether God exists?
questions.explanation: Greek root 'a-' (without) + 'gnosis' (knowledge) se 'Agnostic' banta hai. Ye vyakti kehta hai ki Ishwar ke astitva ka gyan manav buddhi se pare hai. Atheist belief ko reject karta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question: In judicial dispute resolution, an independent person chosen to settle a dispute whose decision is legally binding on all parties is called:
questions.explanation: Rule RC-05 ke anusaar, Arbitrator ka faisla legally binding (Arbitral Award) hota hai. Mediator ya Conciliator sirf aapsi baat-cheet se samjhauta karwate hain bina binding ruling ke.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-05: Dispute Resolution Roles: Arbitrator vs Mediator.

questions.question: Identify the word that designates a facility specifically built for keeping birds:
questions.explanation: Rule RC-03 ke anusaar, Latin root 'avis' (bird) se 'Aviary' banta hai. 'Apis' (bee) se 'Apiary' banta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: Spatial Enclosure Law: Place vs Occupant vs Activity.

questions.subtopic: Memorial Writings: Inscription vs Praise vs Verse
questions.question: A formal speech or written tribute delivered to praise a person highly, usually shortly following their death, is called:
questions.explanation: Rule RC-06 ke anusaar, formal speech of high praise ko 'Eulogy' kehte hain. Qabr ke patthar par khode gaye text ko 'Epitaph' aur shok-kavita ko 'Elegy' kehte hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-06: Literary & Memorial Triad: Epitaph vs Eulogy vs Elegy.

questions.question: An administrative conference that takes place once every two years is correctly referred to as:
questions.explanation: Rule RC-07 ke anusaar, 2 saal mein 1 baar hone wali ghatna ko 'Biennial' kehte hain. Saal mein do baar hone wali ghatna ko 'Biannual' kehte hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-07: Time & Frequency Calculation: Annual vs Biannual vs Biennial.

questions.question: A person who permanently leaves their home country to reside in another country is known as:
questions.explanation: Rule RC-09 ke anusaar, apna desh chhodne wala 'Emigrant' (Exit) hota hai. Doosre desh se aakar basne wala 'Immigrant' (In-coming) hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-09: Migration Directional Vectors: Immigrant vs Emigrant vs Refugee.

questions.subtopic: Legal Terminology: Verdict of Not Guilty
questions.question: Select the correct term for formally freeing an accused person from a criminal charge by a judicial finding of not guilty:
questions.explanation: Rule RC-10 ke anusaar, courtroom trial mein nirdosh paakar bari karna 'Acquit' kahlata hai. Absolve general moral guilt se release ko kehte hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-10: Judicial Verdicts & Culpability: Acquit vs Absolve vs Convict.

questions.question: The defense counsel warned that a contempt proceeding was ________ if the officer failed to file the compliance affidavit by afternoon.
questions.explanation: Rule RC-13 ke anusaar, jo ghatna bohot jald hone wali ho (impending / about to happen) use 'Imminent' kehte hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-13: Phonetic Lookalike Trap: Imminent vs Immanent vs Eminent.

questions.question: A form of government or social system where political governance is dominated by the wealthy is called:
questions.explanation: Greek root 'ploutos' (wealth) se 'Plutocracy' (dhanik-tantra) banta hai. Aristocracy noble birth par aadharit hoti hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Morphological Root Word Decoding.

questions.question: Which verb means to make a bad situation, problem, or pain less severe or intense?
questions.explanation: Rule RC-12 ke anusaar, kisi dard ya sankat ki tivrata ko kam karne ko 'Mitigate' kehte hain. Exacerbate aur Aggravate sthiti ko worse banate hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-12: Severity Modulation: Mitigate vs Ameliorate vs Exacerbate.

questions.question: To formally give up one's monarchical throne or supreme royal position is to:
questions.explanation: Rule RC-11 ke anusaar, rajgaddi ya throne chhodne ke liye specific word 'Abdicate' hota hai. Aam rights ya claims chhodne ke liye 'Renounce' hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-11: Relinquishing Authority: Abdicate vs Renounce.

questions.question:
Select the correct word to fill in the blank:
"The state government engaged a special counsel to ________ the perpetrators of the financial embezzlement."
questions.explanation: Court mein kanooni karyawahi chalane ke liye 'Prosecute' sahi word hai. 'Persecute' kisi par julm ya atyachar karna hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question: A comprehensive book detailing the life and judicial decisions of Chief Justice Khanna written by a legal historian is:
questions.explanation: Kyunki pustak kisi doosre vyakti (legal historian) dwara likhi gayi hai, isliye ye 'Biography' hai. Agar Justice Khanna khud likhte toh 'Autobiography' kahlati.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Definition vs Synonym Precision Rule.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly satisfies both the meaning and the required part of speech for:
"A person who shows selfless concern for the welfare and happiness of others."
questions.explanation: Rule RC-02 ke anusaar, 'A person who...' ek agent noun demand karta hai. 'Altruist' noun hai jo person ko represent karta hai. 'Altruistic' adjective hai aur 'Altruism' abstract noun.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-02: Person vs Quality / Condition Grammatical Concord.
